title: AQA GCSE Chemistry
description:
Complete AQA GCSE Chemistry course covering the 8462 specification.

Topics include:
• Atomic structure and the periodic table
• Bonding, structure, and properties of matter
• Quantitative chemistry
• Chemical changes
• Energy changes
• Rate and extent of chemical change
• Organic chemistry
• Chemical analysis
• Chemistry of the atmosphere
• Using resources

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and exam-style questions.
subject: chemistry
